answers.core:
TextureRect is core, and this only involves rounding a value that is already calculated by the TextureRect node.

---------------------------
An alternative way to solve this is to make TextureRect respect the `gui/common/snap_controls_to_pixels` project setting, but there may be cases where drawing at fractional positions while keeping that setting enabled is desired. I don't know if anyone relies on this behavior though.

--------------------------------

I can implement this myself if there is a consensus that this is wanted. Looking at the TextureRect drawing code it looks very simple and straightforward to do.
answers.workaround: You can reimplement the TextureRect in a script. This is fairly easy to do because of how easily the section of Godot's source code translates to GDScript, but it's still inconvenient.
